extraction_scope: worker-6 bounded mechanism adjudication from source-reviewed XML sections, figure captions, and supplementary NCI-60 context.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AmphiArc2 has direct qualitative evidence of membrane permeabilization/cell death in an MCF7 single-cell microfluidic assay.
direct_assay_types: single-cell microfluidic fluorescence microscopy with calcein-AM cytosol labeling and EpCAM membrane labeling
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct mechanism evidence is qualitative and peptide/cell-context specific; it should not be generalized to every offspring peptide or every NCI-60 line.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Circular dichroism and helical-wheel characterization support amphipathic/helical structural context for AmphiArc2 and optimized offspring peptides.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AmphiArc2, Off2, Off2.2.10 and selected designed peptides
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural context supports mechanism interpretation but is not by itself a direct membrane-disruption assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NCI-60 testing supports broad anticancer growth-inhibition phenotype for AmphiArc2, Off2, and Off2.2.10 but does not establish a separate molecular target.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Panel activity is recorded as phenotypic activity evidence, not promoted to direct mechanism.
